brief_summary: Resistance to empirical antibiotic treatment has resulted in increased mortality and morbidity in serious infections caused by certain common resistant pathogens in the community. The risk for increased mortality has been also the motivation for recent guidelines that suggest early empirical antimicrobial treatment with broad spectrum antibiotics within a few hours of suspecting sepsis, regardless of the potential microorganism or infection focus.
